# Pixelorbits

> Pixelorbits (legal name: Pixel Orbit Digital Solutions) is a design and development studio in Bareilly, India, founded in 2020 by Mohd Bakir. An in-house team of 4 developers and 3 designers designs and builds websites, mobile apps, SaaS products and e-commerce stores for startups and brands in the UK, US, Australia and India.

## Services
- Websites (MERN stack)
- Mobile apps (React Native, Flutter, native)
- E-commerce stores (custom and Shopify)
- SaaS products, dashboards and custom software
- AI integration
- WhatsApp Business API and automation

## How we work
- Free 30-minute call and estimate
- Written scope and fixed price before work starts
- Design in Figma, development by the same in-house team
- 60 days of free support after launch

## Case studies
- [Fasto delivery app](https://www.pixelorbits.com/fasto): student delivery business in Delhi moved off WhatsApp; customer app, partner app, admin panel and website in React Native, about 2 months, team of 3.
- [Sales CRM](https://www.pixelorbits.com/crm): custom CRM design for an IT services company replacing Excel and Google Sheets.
- [Resume builder SaaS](https://www.pixelorbits.com/resume): guided editor, templates, resume check and PDF export.
- [Audio creator platform](https://www.pixelorbits.com/audio): mobile-first web app to record, publish and share audio.
- [Vehicle marketplace app](https://www.pixelorbits.com/vehicles): iOS marketplace for pre-owned vehicles of every kind.
- [WhatsApp business platform](https://www.pixelorbits.com/whatsapp): shared inbox, broadcasts, chatbot and reports on the WhatsApp Business API.
- [Fashion e-commerce store](https://www.pixelorbits.com/fashion): custom store with fit-focused product pages and one-page checkout.
